label: Apple___Apple_scab
solution: Spray Captan 50WP or Mancozeb 75WP (2–3 g per litre). Collect and burn fallen leaves. Prune dense branches to improve sunlight and airflow. Repeat sprays during humid weather.

label: Apple___Black_rot
solution: Remove and destroy mummified fruits. Spray Myclobutanil 10WP or Propiconazole 25EC (1 ml per litre). Keep the orchard clean and remove dead branches or rotten fruits.

label: Apple___Cedar_apple_rust
solution: Spray Myclobutanil 10WP or Hexaconazole 5EC (1 ml per litre). Remove nearby juniper trees because the disease spreads from them. Maintain pruning for airflow.

label: Apple___healthy
solution: Tree is healthy. Continue regular watering, yearly pruning, and apply compost every 2–3 months.

label: Blueberry___healthy
solution: Plant is healthy. Maintain acidic soil (pH 4–5.5). Water regularly using drip irrigation and avoid waterlogging.

label: Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew
solution: Spray Sulfur 80WP (2 g per litre) or Potassium Bicarbonate (5 g per litre). Avoid overhead watering. Improve airflow through pruning.

label: Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy
solution: Healthy tree. Continue regular pruning and watering at the base.

label: Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_spot
solution: Grow resistant varieties. Spray Azoxystrobin 23SC (1 ml per litre). Rotate corn with pulses and remove infected residues.

label: Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_
solution: Use resistant hybrids. Spray Tebuconazole 25EC or Propiconazole 25EC (1 ml per litre). Maintain proper spacing.

label: Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight
solution: Use resistant varieties. Spray Mancozeb 75WP (2 g per litre) early. Rotate corn with legumes to break the disease cycle.

label: Corn_(maize)___healthy
solution: Crop is healthy. Follow recommended water and fertilizer schedule.

label: Grape___Black_rot
solution: Prune infected shoots. Spray Captan 50WP or Myclobutanil 10WP (2 g per litre). Maintain vineyard cleanliness.

label: Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles)
solution: Remove infected wood. Avoid pruning during wet weather. Improve irrigation but avoid excess water.

label: Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spot)
solution: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50WP (3 g per litre). Remove dead leaves. Improve airflow by proper spacing.

label: Grape___healthy
solution: Vine is healthy. Continue pruning for good sunlight exposure.

label: Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening)
solution: No cure exists. Remove infected trees. Control psyllids using Imidacloprid 17.8SL (0.3 ml per litre). Maintain orchard cleanliness.

label: Peach___Bacterial_spot
solution: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50WP (3 g per litre). Use resistant cultivars. Use drip irrigation instead of overhead watering.

label: Peach___healthy
solution: Tree is healthy. Continue pruning and apply compost regularly.

label: Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot
solution: Spray Copper hydroxide or Copper oxychloride (3 g per litre). Avoid touching plants when wet. Use drip irrigation.

label: Pepper,_bell___healthy
solution: Healthy plant. Maintain soil fertility and check leaves regularly.

label: Potato___Early_blight
solution: Spray Mancozeb 75WP or Chlorothalonil 75WP (2 g per litre). Remove early yellow leaves. Rotate crops.

label: Potato___Late_blight
solution: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) 2 g per litre. Destroy infected tubers. Avoid overhead irrigation.

label: Potato___healthy
solution: Crop is healthy. Maintain proper soil moisture and drainage.

label: Raspberry___healthy
solution: Plant is healthy. Maintain pruning and spacing for good airflow.

label: Soybean___healthy
solution: Crop is healthy. Continue weed control and crop rotation.

label: Squash___Powdery_mildew
solution: Spray Potassium Bicarbonate (5 g per litre) or Sulfur 80WP (2 g per litre). Improve airflow and reduce humidity.

label: Strawberry___Leaf_scorch
solution: Remove infected leaves. Improve irrigation. Spray Copper fungicides (2–3 g per litre).

label: Strawberry___healthy
solution: Plant is healthy. Maintain spacing and avoid overcrowding.

label: Tomato___Bacterial_spot
solution: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50WP (3 g per litre). Avoid overhead watering. Rotate crops.

label: Tomato___Early_blight
solution: Spray Chlorothalonil or Copper fungicides (2 g per litre). Remove lower leaves touching soil. Improve airflow.

label: Tomato___Late_blight
solution: Spray Mancozeb + Metalaxyl (Ridomil Gold) 2 g per litre. Remove infected plants. Avoid wetting leaves.

label: Tomato___Leaf_Mold
solution: Increase ventilation and reduce humidity. Spray Copper fungicides (2 g per litre).

label: Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot
solution: Remove lower leaves. Spray Chlorothalonil 75WP (2 g per litre). Avoid watering leaves directly.

label: Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite
solution: Use Neem oil (5 ml per litre) or Spiromesifen 22.9SC. Wash leaves weekly.

label: Tomato___Target_Spot
solution: Remove infected leaves. Spray Copper fungicides or Mancozeb (2 g per litre). Avoid overhead watering.

label: Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus
solution: Remove infected plants. Control whiteflies with Imidacloprid 17.8SL (0.3 ml per litre). Use resistant hybrids.

label: Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus
solution: Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools using soap. Avoid handling tobacco before touching plants.

label: Tomato___healthy
solution: Plant is healthy. Maintain balanced fertilization and prune side shoots regularly.
